label: measured
method: The same project was compiled each way. Its source holds #if __has_include checks for a canary file outside the project and for the moki.env path, raising #error if a file is visible. Only existence was tested: no file contents were read.

inSandboxUnderNoNewPrivileges.note: Run in a unit with NoNewPrivileges and PrivateTmp, like moki.service, so the wrapper hands the compile to its own user unit.

hardenedInSandbox.note: After review: read-only toolchain and a per-library-set folder. The source still holds the visibility checks.

finding: bwrap fails under NoNewPrivileges with "No permissions to create new namespace". The first live build under moki.service failed this way, and the wrapper now starts a separate user unit.
